items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: I like Vega and my son, they'd run a band, you see. They'd manage it and all. All they'd do is they'd get the instructions from me.

ctx.x: Yeah. See? Mm-hmm. So, you had a lot of managing things to do. You had to manage. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Well, you see, I wouldn't have to do

all the managing myself. Now, like I had Manuel Marlowe, he used to run a band himself, poor band himself, Manuel Marlowe, you see, and I like Vega and my son, they'd run a band, you see. They'd manage it and all. All they'd do is they'd get the instructions from me. See, I'd give them the instructions and give them the contract and everything else. Well, they'd collect and sign and give receipts and all that sort of stuff, illegally, you know what I mean? They wouldn't need me there then, you see. I see.
